selector.rationale: Neutrophilic panniculitis is supported by skin biopsy showing subcorneal and subepidermal edema and a dense acute neutrophilic infiltrate extending into adipose tissue and septa, consistent with previous biopsy results.

rejected.label: Ulcerative colitis flare
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of ulcerative colitis, the current symptoms and biopsy results do not strongly support a flare of this condition.

rejected.label: Autoimmune vasculitis
rejected.why: The lack of direct immunofluorescence and limited supporting evidence make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Azathioprine-induced vasculitis
rejected.why: The low score and limited evidence for this condition make it an unlikely cause of the patient's symptoms.
